svg.text: #993 — Settings → Maintenance: Prune + Archive old missions
Desktop · dark · tokens from docs/design.md §3 · existing cards dimmed, new cards marked NEW · socket / scrollback / database figures measured on a real host, others illustrative

g.text: Archive sessions you haven’t touched in a while. Archived sessions are hidden from the
list but can be unarchived — nothing is deleted.

svg.text: Archive finished missions (done, failed or abandoned). Their sessions are archived
with them: live terminals are stopped, transcripts are kept. A mission with an
unresolved turn is skipped. Archived missions can be unarchived.

g.text: Terminal history is cached on disk per session so scrollback survives restarts.
Clearing only drops cached scrollback — sessions and their on-disk history stay.

svg.text: Remove BattleLab’s own leftovers. Session history is never deleted, and nothing is
removed until you confirm. Sizes are a dry run.
No live session behind them. A socket a new session holds is never touched.
Same as Scrollback cache → Clear archived sessions’ cache.
Can’t compact: 13 opencode processes have the database open.
Nothing to reclaim yet: space frees only after opencode itself deletes data.

g.text: Compact database, only if idle at run time
Also archive finished missions older than
